title: Do you Have a Go-Bag Ready?
description:
If you had to suddenly leave your home, do you have a go-bag ready? 

Mayor Gloria encourages San Diegans to be prepared with an emergency plan and to make a go bag with necessary supplies for your family and pets, as we anticipate severe weather conditions this fall and winter. 

September is National Preparedness Month, and the City's Office of Emergency Services is reminding everyone to be ready. Find more resources at sandiego.gov/elnino or click the Link in Bio.
